digest.component_or_area: fsck authorship check and seam signing
propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolved and require_authenticated is off, masking the inability to sign
fsck authorship tally is aggregated store-wide without per-env breakdown, making it invisible when a single env writes 0% signed events while others write healthy volume

fsck must report any env_id with zero signed events or all Unknown-authored events as a counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue, gated to fire only when that env wrote at or after the store's earliest signed event
_apply_authorship must emit a WARNING log when signing is skipped due to missing author_id or signing_key, naming the event uuid and ticket, while remaining best-effort and not failing any write
Dormant pre-signing envs must not trigger false-positive unsigned-env findings, requiring adoption-gating on the store's first signed event timestamp
